IMPORT.TITLE: Import Invoices
IMPORT.SKIP_DUPLICATES_DESC: Invoices whose number already exists are skipped. Turn this off to report them as errors instead.
IMPORT.SKIP_DUPLICATE_LINES_DESC: Within an invoice, a line identical to an earlier one (same item, quantity, price, discount and description) is skipped.
IMPORT.AUTO_NUMBER_DESC: Invoice numbers are generated from your numbering settings. Any invoice numbers in the file are ignored.
IMPORT.TIP_ROWS: Each row of the file is one invoice line. Rows with the same invoice number are imported as one invoice.
IMPORT.TIP_MATCH: Customers and items must already exist. Customers are matched by name; items by barcode first, then SKU, then name, and must be available in this branch. An invoice with an unknown customer or unavailable item is reported as an error.
IMPORT.TIP_STATUS: Supported statuses are Draft and Open; an invoice with another status can be fixed in the Preview step. Invoice numbers that already exist are skipped, or reported as errors when Skip duplicate invoices is off.
